release: LGAE v5.3.2 — Research improvements: Q-learning, hierarchical retrieval, gauge norm control
test_note: Full suite passes in a single pytest invocation (~20s) from the installed wheel (no PYTHONPATH override). +22 new tests for v5.3.2 research improvements.

policy_qualification.note: The original supervised policy gate remains at 83.3%. The new Q(S,a) controller (scripts/train_q_controller.py) achieves 86% accuracy on held-out topology families, a significant improvement over the supervised policy's 30%.

q_controller.approach: Q(S,a) = E[ΔU(S,a)] trained on 14400 counterfactual outcomes across 8 topology families
q_controller.note: The Q-network does better on held-out families than in-distribution because some in-distribution families (star, cycle) have zero ΔU for all actions, making the correct action ambiguous. Wheel and caveman have clearer structural interventions.

research_improvements.graph_feature_baseline: Replaced GraphHashBaseline with GraphFeatureBaseline (online ridge regression on 16-dim structural features). Similar graph states now produce similar baseline predictions, reducing variance in advantage estimation.
research_improvements.hierarchical_candidate_retrieval: Replaced top-24 node candidate generation with top-64 + latent-distance KNN retrieval (4 neighbors per node, 512 max pairs). Correct endpoints outside the top-64 are now reachable via KNN.
research_improvements.dynamic_gauge_norm_clamping: Added generator Frobenius norm clamping (default max=1.0) after antisymmetrization. Prevents Cayley conditioning problems and bounds the Jacobian of the state-dependent gauge map. Spectral norm available as opt-in.
research_improvements.equilibrium_barrier_upgrade: Upgraded from pure state-delta to combined state-delta + dynamics residual. Now checks ||F(z_t) - z_t|| / ||z_t|| in addition to ||z_t - z_{t-1}|| / ||z_{t-1}||, catching periodic orbits and metastable plateaus that the old check missed.
research_improvements.counterfactual_dataset: New module generates (state, action, ΔU) triples across 8 topology families (path, cycle, grid, star, BA, WS, random, bipartite) with 3 held-out families (wheel, lollipop, caveman).
research_improvements.q_learning: Q(S,a) trained via MSE regression on counterfactual outcomes. Policy derived as argmax_a Q(S,a) instead of supervised action classification.

torch_compile.architecture: fixed-shape sparse numerical kernels; eager discrete evolution

integrity.manifest_note: MANIFEST.sha256.json regenerated as the final step after all other artifacts were immutable.

release_boundary_note: All qualification artifacts regenerated from installed 5.3.2 wheel. Version constant, pyproject.toml, schema constants, README, CHANGELOG, and BUILD_REPORT all agree on 5.3.2.
